description: Baking, garage repairs, cycling, tiling, floor sanding, gutter work and a convertible roof keep Pat and Mat moving between home improvement and transport, with every attempt at efficiency inviting a more ambitious contraption.

s06e01.description: Running out of biscuits prompts Pat and Mat to bake their own. The quantity of dough quickly outgrows normal kitchen equipment, forcing them to scale the entire baking process upward.

s06e02.description: After the garage door is damaged, Pat and Mat decide to replace it. Their attempt to upgrade the entrance becomes a battle with heavy panels, mechanisms and the question of what a garage really needs for a door.

s06e03.description: Pat and Mat prepare for a bicycle outing, but balancing riders, luggage and unreliable bikes leads them through training wheels, improvised combinations and repeated redesigns of the transport itself.

s06e04.description: Faced with a stack of tiles that must be moved, Pat and Mat build a delivery system to avoid carrying them by hand, only to discover that efficiency and fragility do not always cooperate.

s06e05.description: Dirty parquet flooring needs sanding, so Pat and Mat mechanize the job and soon turn floor renovation into something closer to a race, with the surface itself paying the price for their enthusiasm.

s06e06.description: Painting a high gutter proves awkward, so Pat and Mat construct increasingly unstable ways to reach it, eventually engineering a lifting system from tools and household hardware.

s06e07.description: A convertible roof refuses to cooperate just as bad weather threatens a trip. Pat and Mat replace the failed mechanism with their own ideas about shelter and mobile weather protection.
